# Vestas i kursfest - aktien kan nå op mod kurs 400, spår investor

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-08-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Earnings-week episode dominated by Vestas, which surged 18% on a guidance upgrade and a big gross-margin beat, prompting bullish medium/long-term targets toward DKK 400. Hosts also weighed Matas (disappointed on Swedish Kicks unit), ChemoMetec (Roche partnership seen as transformational), and NKT (expected Friday upgrade on electrification/grid backlog), before a broad debate on AI concentration risk urging diversification and picking downstream AI beneficiaries. Overall constructive on green-energy/electrification and grid infrastructure, but cautious on stretched US tech valuations.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guidance upgrade plus 17% gross margin vs 12.6% expected; turbine profitability inflecting, 41bn service backlog; Ole targets ~400 with 15-20% annual return.

#### Reasoning

Ole bought Vestas for the All-Star portfolio; sees EPS up 10-12% this year and another 10% next, turbine gross margin rising from <10% to ~17-18%, and a lucrative multi-year service backlog that alone could justify the market cap. Holds until 15-20% annual return no longer visible. Thomas is constructive but prefers to wait for consistent execution rather than chase the first +100%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if annual return outlook falls below 15-20%
- if the stock becomes too expensive
- if earnings growth begins to fade
- if service-division margin fails to move toward 22-25%

> *"Så vi kommer in i underkanten av 400 om några år. Och om du lägger dig om till årlig investeringsavkast inklusive lite utbyte så ligger det i intervallet 15-20%"*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Preferred electrification play over Vestas; strong order backlog at good prices, improving medium/high-voltage margins, Karlskrona capacity; possible guidance upgrade Friday.

#### Reasoning

Möbbet has owned NKT over Vestas for years as a safer way to play electrification. Order-winning is a given; the value driver is execution on cable delivery and rising margins on backlog taken at strong prices. Peers Nexans and Prysmian posted strong results, supporting a read-across. Thomas expects a possible upgrade Friday, though expectations are now built into the price after a strong run.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Rhine low-water levels delay cable shipments from the production plant
- if execution/margins disappoint versus already-elevated expectations
- if the order backlog margins deteriorate

> *"Jag tror mycket väl att du kan förvänta dig en uppjustering när vi kommer på fredag."*

---

### 🟢 CHEMM — ChemoMetec | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Roche deal to commercialize XM30 (20% royalty) with ChemoMetec keeping consumables/service revenue; ~3bn instrument replacement market by 2029, 500m aftermarket at 90%+ margin.

#### Reasoning

Held in the All-Star portfolio; Roche partnership described by one institutional holder as the biggest opportunity ever, replacing legacy ZX instruments before 2029. Razor-and-blade model keeps consumables revenue with ChemoMetec. Ole finds the business genuinely interesting and, if the data hold, not expensive versus a possible doubling of revenue; but the stock is volatile with a history of negative surprises and hard to quantify near-term impact.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Roche royalty/commercialization ramp disappoints
- if instrument replacement volumes fall short of the ~3bn estimate
- if the company reverts to negative earnings surprises

> *"detta partnerskap är efter vårt värdering den största möjligheten Kemometic någonsin har haft"*

---

### 🟡 MATAS — Matas | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Danish core solid but Swedish Kicks unit dragging group margin via inventory clearance; new CEO cost cuts; cheap (~10 EPS, ~85 price) and a concentrated-ownership takeover candidate.

#### Reasoning

Ole bought Matas and is disappointed by the Kicks-driven margin miss but sees a cheap stock (~8x earnings), OPEX savings from the new CEO, and takeover appeal with ~35% held by few investors (Cobas, Bestseller, ATP, Danske Invest). Thomas prefers to wait, arguing the thesis needs proof of execution on Kicks integration and Swedish sales growth, not cost synergies; happy to miss the first 30-50%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish Kicks sales stay negative / integration fails
- if the CEO leans on financial engineering instead of sales growth
- if guidance for the year is cut
- if no takeover materializes and execution lags

> *"Jag vill hellre gå glipp av de första 50 procent på den här. För dem handlar det om att de ska levera."*

---

### 🟡 CARL-B — Carlsberg | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong summer and football-tournament boost, Britvic transformation into multi-brand beverage house, India listing optionality; China still weak; trim near 4-digit share price.

#### Reasoning

Thomas sees positives to grab: favorable summer weather, tournament-driven volumes in strong markets, possible short-term upgrade, and structural upside from the Britvic integration synergies plus India/Kazakhstan improvement. But China remains the biggest challenge and the stock has repeatedly failed to hold above the 1000 (4-digit) level, so he would take profits near the top rather than go 'full house'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share price reaches four digits (take profits)
- if Britvic integration synergies fail to materialize
- if China weakness deepens

> *"jag syns vi ska, när det kommer fyra siffror på Carlsberg-kursen, så... Så tar du måske lige toppen av."*

---

### 🟠 MAERSK-B — Maersk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Reports Thursday and already delivered a guidance upgrade in June; hosts flag it as one to watch in the earnings week.

#### Reasoning

Maersk is cited positively as having pre-announced a June upgrade ahead of Thursday's report, making it a watch item for the earnings week, but the hosts give no explicit buy/sell conviction or detailed thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Thursday's report walks back the June upgrade
- if freight-rate conditions deteriorate

> *"Torsdag kommer det regnskap från Maersk. Där fick vi alldeles i juni en uppjustering."*

---
